comments.text:
This company (Niva Bupa) is extremely disappointing, and this YouTuber’s promotion feels misleading. After watching her videos, I chose the Niva Bupa policy over others and paid a higher premium because everything looked trustworthy after my research.

I’ve been paying premiums for almost two years now. Recently, I tried to contact customer service for a basic annual health check-up. The app shows it as already booked — which is a glitch because I never booked it — yet I cannot reach anyone from their team. I’ve sent emails and called multiple numbers, but there has been no response at all. If this is the situation for a routine request, I can’t imagine what happens during a real emergency.

My recommendation: don’t hand over your hard-earned money expecting premium service during a medical crisis. In reality, you may struggle even to get support, let alone reimbursement equal to what you’ve paid.

It’s better to save your money yourself and use it wisely when needed.

comments.text:
@gauravshukla4329   My husband has Niva bupa Reassure plan since last 3 years. We are newly married Jan-24. He wants to include me in his policy as family floater plan. In the renewal time, he paid premium (As you need to pay first) then he send my past medical history. After that his entire policy is terminated by underwriting team. & his PED waiting period which he served also gone... delayed to premium back...

I have doubt that if they delayed to your premium back then what will happen in claim time. ICR is reflecting the picture. 

My point is when I have medical history why my husband's policy is terminated by underwriting team? They didn't give me policy but continue to my husband policy.

2nd point is Niva bupa customer care service is another level, you have to maintained main balance in your phone. We all are recharge unlimited free call to any network. But Niva bupa customer care number have extraordinary, you have to maintain main balance to call them.. & waiting/Holding time is 30mnts so that you have to recharge by topup by Rs 100/- don't recharge by 20/- it is not sufficient.

Please rectify my if I m wrong.. 🙏
